items.title: What Could Push TPR Stock Higher From Here?
items.summary: At $128.39, Tapestry (TPR) looks set up for roughly 22% upside over the next three years under a conservative scenario. Not a big number, and most of what the business is doing is already in the price. The question is whether even this modest move is defensible. Revenue compounding does all the work, because the scenario holds the multiple flat at today's level rather than assuming any re-rating. Here is the operational reality the math is built on.
